title: Data Classes in Python (Guide) - Real Python
snippet: The @dataclass decorator, introduced in Python 3.7, automatically implements __init__, __repr__ and __eq__ based on class variables with type annotations, avoiding boilerplate code.

title: dataclasses - Data Classes - Python documentation
snippet: A field is defined as a class variable that has a type annotation. Decorator parameters include init=True, repr=True, eq=True, order=False and frozen=False.
